testResults.name: determinism-golden-harness
testResults.result: 9 tests passed for repeated byte-identical runs, canonical artifact and manifest hashes, and deliberate set-order, clock, random-value, and ID nondeterminism failures.

testResults.name: focused-quality
testResults.result: Focused Ruff lint, format, and ty checks passed; golden runs own fresh SimClock, EventBus, venue, portfolio, strategy binding, and seeded inputs without global state.

decisions: Golden artifacts use canonical JSON and homogeneous event Parquet bytes, with manifests carrying configuration and artifact digests.
Unordered sets, binary floats, unseeded external values, and unstable IDs are rejected rather than normalized silently.
